messages.author: 4f9701b3dc2dae8c
messages.subject: inconsistent hjust with facet_grid scales="free"
parts:
Hi,

Using this code, I get inconsistent justification of the x axis text
--- the left facet is correctly justified but the right facet isn't:

d <- data.frame(a=rnorm(100),
b=factor(sample(c("A", "B", "C"), 100, TRUE)),
c=factor(sample(c("1", "2"), 100, TRUE)))

d2 <- d[d$c == "1" | (d$c == "2" & d$b == "C"),]

ggplot(d2, aes(x=b, y=a)) + facet_grid(~ c, space="free",
scales="free") + geom_point() + opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90,
hjust=1))

compare with

ggplot(d2, aes(x=b, y=a)) + facet_grid(~ c, space="free") +
geom_point() + opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90, hjust=1))

Is this a bug?

Thanks,
Gad

Hi, now I figure out that this is due to the recent modification.
If you use only the combination of angle = 90 and hjust = 1, then
ggplot-0.8.8 works better.
So, put code below before calling ggplot2:

== from here ==
guide_axis <- function(at, labels, position="right", theme) {
position <- match.arg(position, c("top", "bottom", "right", "left"))

at <- unit(at, "native")
length <- theme$axis.ticks.length
label_pos <- length + theme$axis.ticks.margin
one <- unit(1, "npc")

label_render <- switch(position,
top = , bottom = "axis.text.x",
left = , right = "axis.text.y"
)
label_x <- switch(position,
top = ,
bottom = at,
right = label_pos,
left = one - label_pos
)
label_y <- switch(position,
top = label_pos,
bottom = one - label_pos,
right = ,
left = at,
)

if (is.list(labels)) {
if (any(sapply(labels, is.language))) {
labels <- do.call(expression, labels)
} else {
labels <- unlist(labels)
}
}

labels <- theme_render(theme, label_render, labels, label_x, label_y)

line <- switch(position,
top = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 0, 0, 1, 0),
bottom = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 0, 1, 1, 1),
right = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 0, 1, 0, 1),
left = theme_render(theme, "axis.line", 1, 0, 1, 1)
)

ticks <- switch(position,
top = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", at, 0, at, length),
bottom = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", at, one - length, at, 1),
right = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", 0, at, length, at),
left = theme_render(theme, "axis.ticks", one - length, at, 1, at)
)

absoluteGrob(
gList(ticks, labels, line),
width = grobWidth(labels) + label_pos,
height = grobHeight(labels) + label_pos
)
}
assignInNamespace("guide_axis",guide_axis, "ggplot2")

== to here ==

Note that if you want to use hjust 0 with angle = 90, then ggplot2 can
correctly handle, for example, try these in ggplot2-0.8.8 (i.e., but
the code above before calling) and ggplot2-0.8.9

ggplot(d2, aes(x=b, y=a)) + facet_grid(~ c, space="free",
scale="free") + geom_point() + opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=90,
ggplot(d2, aes(x=b, y=a)) + facet_grid(~ c, space="free",

scale="free") + geom_point() + opts(axis.text.x=theme_text(angle=270,
hjust=0.5))

but the mistake is that, when I work with them, I never took care about facet...
sorry for inconvenient.

I have a quick and dirty hack to fix this problem in new version, but
will consider more in this holiday ;)

what I mean is that ggplot2-0.8.8 works well when hjust=1 and angle=90
and multiple facet.
ggplot2-0.8.9 works well hjust=0 and angle=90, and some other
combinations, but only for one facet or axis text of all facet are
same size (width in y axis, height in x axis).

Here is examples:
http://kohske.wordpress.com/2010/12/24/rotation-and-justification-of-axis-texts-in-ggplot2/
